additional_info.subject: RE: ID0418510-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / N8 160365547 ERK] Charger out of Service CRM:02679000100
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
We have a ticket regarding SPD fault, making the charger out of order.
Please check the SPD for 2 things:
If these terminals are fitted properly or not damaged
If the Green box above the PE is red
If the green box is red please replace the SPD.
If everything checks out, then please measure continuity between the 3 fuses:
MLFB NO. 8EM5903-0AA00-2AA0 -FA1 SPD Type1/Type2 3P+N 400VAC
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0418510 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
